book.name: James
book.title: Soo James ka Mu Jew Numu-matoo Tubo

content: Mu tubetse ewow hee-ga'yoo numu sakwa ka tu manekwuna soopedakwatoona, umu sumuna sakwikwu, soo suda mu tumadugupu umu-matoosoo kodyukwu.
Soo mu hee-gana yungusanadooadooa tookana-kwana, mu wunapu kwasu unu nanenakadu mu woabe sooakwu.

Umuoo ka mu tzapoonnekuna ka saa'a gi hee manepetukwu. Umu meeoo sokwama, “Numme ewatsekoo hemma hee-ga'yoo, nummesoo oo nanomatugukwu.” Pana gi! Umu moogoobuna soo suda mu tumadugupu mu-matoosoo kodyukwu. Oosoo goso-wa'ne'yoo, oosoosoo ka saa'a mu kootsasooakukwu. Tooe ka suda namanedu umu-matoosoo kodyuse sapa, umu togesoo ewow tu hee geapunnena soogwipunne.
Umu ooosapa ka pumme tumatzidu wumoo'aga ka umu mu natumanagaku-kwi. Umu mu tumatziwabe ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhi. Soo Te Naa unu naduyadu pooha-ga'yoo, mu nanekwegeakwu.
Yaa ka teepu-koobatu ewow mu hee-gana ka unu moogoobuna besa sokwamana yabesoo ewa mu hee-gana gadoo namayugwekwu.
Umu besa'yoo numu puu nabatsakwu umu ka besa'yoona, ka gi umu-punatusoo mawa'e. Pana saa'a soo suda mu manepu umu-matasoo kodyukwu.

E pupua'amu, tamme sakwa gi nasootookepana tuutooe, ka Te Pabe'e yaa teepu-koobatoosoo oo kodyukwuno'otoo, soo tumasuadu puu tuutooe. Oosoo tumasuadu puu besow ka a pooe masu'a. Soo tumasuadu yise ewatsekoo baa wutooe, o'nosoo oo tumasuana besa naakwu. Soo tumasuadu wutooe besow oo naakwuna, tuwazoo oo kwasukwuna, o'no yise oo kwasuse, oo yasakwu.
Tamme sakwa yise ka Te Pabe'e kodyukwuna wutooe, pudusoo oosoo tamme-baasoo kodyu petukwu.
Pudusoo Te Pabe'e te tunemadabuekukwu. Tamme sakwa yise gi mu tunaka'oedyukudu suda netammanapana. Tamme ka suda mu netammana, soo Te Naa punno'o suda te netammakwu.
E pupua'amu, mu te nanamooatupu Te Naa nanayadooakudu te tzapoonnekute umu puu gi nasootooke tooe suda manepunnepana.

Ka saa'a soo Te Naa mu tubetse sootuhikwu. Soo nana, Job mee naneadu, puu ootoogoo meapu, oosoo nanasuda manepu pana gi nasootooke. Ka saa'a soo Te Naa no'oko hemma besa oo matabueku. Soo Te Naa ooonne'yoo besa'yoo oosoo tamme tu sootuhina yise tamme tu tumatzina petzape.

Yise e pupua'amu, tamme sakwa ooosapa toge-kwitu numu tuukwe. Tamme meeoo unena, “Gi esayipana, o togetukana o waha. Tamme ka meeoo unena, tooetoo ka oo kwayadu-kwisoo unena oosoo sakwa ka gi kaaheno unena, soo Te Naasoo saa'a te nemadabuedooa.”
Tamme sakwa ka suda manepunnena nanesootuhi. Ka besa sokwamana tamme sakwa tunekwu Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina.
Sumu'yoo tamme-nagatu ka tuoeyise, mu tunaka'oedyukudu moohedu sakwa oosoo nekwi. Ka oo-baa petuse, ka yoohoo oo-ma oo tsematzuase nanesootuhiku.
Tamme ka nanesootuhina tunaka'oedyukuna, soo Te Pabe'e ka tuoeyaedu numu besa mayugweyakwe. Soo tuoeya'edu numu tuwazoo ka tuma'emakwase, soo Te Naa oo soomu'wakwu.

Tamme sakwa ka tuma'emukwana kaaheno toge-witu nanatuukwena ka tuma'emukwana, yise nanano nanesootuhina, tamme yise besa manekwu. Soo besa tunakabetseadu numu ka oo nanesootuhikuna oosoo ka ewow pooha-gana ewa besa tumayukwe.

Ka o'nosoo soo nana Elijah mee naneadu ooonne'yoo. Oosoo uga tamme-wa'ne'yoosoo: sukwe numu. Oosoo ka Te Naa nanetsagwaya'e yise nanesootuhina, ka gi tu powmakwuna nekwise. Esoo gi powmakwu pahe tomo-baa no'oko naapahe muha-baawitoo gi powmakwu.
Soo Elijah yise nanesootuhi, powmabe nekwina, yise powmabetu, no'yoona mu hee namasuadu besa naa.
E pupua'amu, soo numu ka Te Naa besa po ma'wukase, tamme sakwa oetusoo oo nekodyuku.
Tamme ka ne'emukwadu ka Te Naa besa podo nekodyuse, tamme oo ya'ekwuna-makoo oo magwetzoi, soo suda oo tumaduguna yise nasoomu'wukwu. Yaatoo nu a nemoobekwakakwu.
